councilCandidates.name: Thomas Santoro
councilCandidates.experience: Incumbent civic executive with over 6 years of municipal leadership in Pompton Lakes; spearheaded balanced annual budgets within the certified 2% statutory cap.
councilCandidates.tagline: Prudent fiscal discipline, debt containment, and road paving across Pompton Lakes.
keyPlatformPillars: Protecting Pompton Lakes's residential tax base by strictly adhering to the 2% annual tax levy cap.
Expanding municipal paving and storm drainage capital improvements without long-term debt spikes.

councilCandidates.tagline: Zero-based budget audits and public safety modernization.

boeCandidates.name: Kimberly Sullivan
boeCandidates.term: Vote for up to 3 • 3-Year Full Term (2027–2029)
boeCandidates.experience: Incumbent School Board Trustee with 3 years of service on curriculum and finance committees in Pompton Lakes Public Schools.
boeCandidates.keyFocus: Academic excellence, STEM curriculum integration, and student mental wellness support.
boeCandidates.fiscalStance: Prudent management of the $39.5M school operating budget; prioritizing direct classroom funding over administrative overhead.
boeCandidates.infrastructureStance: Upgrading classroom ventilation, science labs, and building security systems.

interviewStances.keyInterviewQuote: Our public schools are the foundation of Pompton Lakes's community and property values. Every dollar must be invested with accountability.
interviewStances.keyPriorities: Classroom instruction, special education resources, and 2% tax levy cap discipline.
interviewStances.facilitiesAndBudget: Transparent school budgets and energy-efficient building upgrades.

boeCandidates.name: Brian DeLuca
boeCandidates.term: Vote for up to 3 • 3-Year Full Term (2027–2029)
boeCandidates.experience: Educator and longtime PTA leader; focused on teacher retention, special education services, and transparent school board governance in Pompton Lakes.
boeCandidates.keyFocus: Supporting classroom teachers, early literacy benchmarks, and career/technical readiness.
boeCandidates.fiscalStance: Ensuring state school aid is maximized and shared services are leveraged with municipal DPW.
boeCandidates.infrastructureStance: Maintaining athletic fields, ADA accessibility, and safe school walking corridors.

interviewStances.keyInterviewQuote: Supporting our classroom educators and students is the highest civic calling. We must ensure every child succeeds.
interviewStances.keyPriorities: Early literacy, school security, and collaborative board governance.
interviewStances.facilitiesAndBudget: Zero-waste educational procurement and community facility use.

boeCandidates.name: Sarah Kowalski
boeCandidates.term: Vote for up to 3 • 3-Year Full Term (2027–2029)
boeCandidates.experience: Certified public accountant and parent of two district students; advocates for transparent school audits and competitive vendor bidding in Pompton Lakes.
boeCandidates.keyFocus: Auditing school operational expenses, expanding advanced placement programs, and student safety.
boeCandidates.fiscalStance: Auditing out-of-district vendor contracts to redirect administrative savings directly into student desks.
boeCandidates.infrastructureStance: Comprehensive facility structural reviews and modernizing security vestibules.

interviewStances.keyInterviewQuote: Accountability to both school parents and fixed-income senior taxpayers is fully achievable with forensic budget oversight.
interviewStances.keyPriorities: Competitive vendor bidding, STEM labs, and transparent public budget workshops.
interviewStances.facilitiesAndBudget: Rigorous oversight of capital referendums and facility repairs.

boeCandidates.name: Richard Kowalski
boeCandidates.term: Vote for up to 3 • 3-Year Full Term (2027–2029)
boeCandidates.experience: Healthcare professional and community youth sports coach; campaigns for expanded arts, athletics, and mental health counseling in Pompton Lakes.
boeCandidates.keyFocus: Student wellness counseling, arts and music funding, and anti-bullying programs.
boeCandidates.fiscalStance: Seeking competitive educational grants to fund specialized learning labs.
boeCandidates.infrastructureStance: Safe drop-off traffic loops and modernizing school libraries into digital media centers.

interviewStances.keyInterviewQuote: A holistic education prepares our students for life. We must invest in both the mind and the well-being of every student.
interviewStances.keyPriorities: Counseling staff ratios, performing arts, and inclusive extracurriculars.
interviewStances.facilitiesAndBudget: State grant acquisition and sustainable community partnerships.
